from openpyxl import load_workbook
p='inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx'
wb=load_workbook(p,read_only=True,data_only=True)
ws=wb['Tumor vs Normal']
headers=[c.value for c in next(ws.iter_rows())]
print(headers)
for i,row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True),2):
    vals=dict(zip(headers,row))
    gene=str(vals.get('gene') or '')
    desc=str(vals.get('Description') or '')
    if gene.upper()=='ENO1' or 'ENO1' in desc.upper() or 'ENOLASE' in desc.upper():
        print(i, vals)
PY"
